T_k: A soft gate on x4**2 minus an offset near 1 and a share of abs(x2*x5) decides whether a row belongs to class_2. Where the gate is open, class_2 is boosted and the other classes are suppressed. Where it is closed, a steep tanh of x2*x5 splits class_1 (positive product) from class_0 (negative product) and class_2 is lightly suppressed.
